**Published Date**: 2017-01-01
**Source URL**: [https://www.poten.com/groundhog-day/](https://www.poten.com/groundhog-day/)

**Coverage**: Full PDF archived locally under reports/poten/pdfs/2017/Weekly-Opinion-January-5-2017-Groundhog-Day.pdf. Analysis & Overview
Groundhog Day
5 Jan 2017: There were only minor changes in the rankings of the top dirty spot charterers in 2016 as compared to 2015. Unipec, Shell and Vitol claimed the top positions as they did last year.
